facts.fact: The government's National Rural Connectivity Program (PNCR) aims to reach 575 rural localities and about 825,675 residents by December 2025, with a second phase from 1 August adding 16 villages, and to continue into 2026, per the Ministry of Digital Transition.
Under the PNCR, seven rural localities across several regions were reported connected, with radio sites activated from 15 July 2025.
